designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1942 on lands of the Santee Cooper hydroelectric project to replace waterfowl habitat lost to the new reservoirs.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Santee National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

South Carolina Encyclopedia: Santee National Wildlife Refuge ("Established in 1942 ... to alleviate the loss of natural waterfowl and wildlife habitat caused by the construction of hydroelectric projects")

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Santee National Wildlife Refuge, encompassing 15,000 acres, was established in 1942 and is located in the upper Atlantic Coastal Plain region of South Carolina.
